description.text: Introduction of One-to-one Course In addition to class (group) teaching, a one-to-one teaching course is also prepared for any individual who wants to study Chinese at a certain level or for a special purpose. Target of teaching Anyone in good health, no limit of age, curious about China, ready to improve his/her Chinese proficiency, and to take an HSK test. Goal of teaching To satisfy a particular need of the learner, prioritize practice and purpose, and improve the ability to use Chinese. Contents of teaching Chinese language courses and the related courses such as Chinese Culture, Politics, Economics and History are taught in light of the individual student's specific intension. Textbooks Upon the choice made by the individual student, as requested. Form of teaching one student one teacher. Time of teaching Fixed as negotiated. Prerequisites of admission Healthy, having received senior high school education or higher. Tuition CNY100 / Hour

duration.text: The One-to-one Chinese Language Program at Guangxi Normal University is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 13 USD/per hour ￥ 100 CNY/per hour

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Well behaved, healthy, and willing to abide by the Law of the People's Republic of China and the Rules and Regulations of Guangxi Normal University.
